chapters.name: Unit 1 Part Two New Words

words.ex: Aha! I found my keys!
words.ex_cn: 啊哈！我找到我的钥匙了！
words.en: An exclamation expressing surprise, triumph, or satisfaction.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: The bureaucrat signed the paper slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这位官僚慢慢地签了那张纸。
words.en: A bureaucrat is an official who works in a bureaucracy, especially one who follows rules and procedures rigidly.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.tr: n. 漫画家；动画片画家；
words.ex: The cartoonist draws funny animals for children's magazines.
words.ex_cn: 这位漫画家为儿童杂志画有趣的小动物。
words.en: A cartoonist is an artist who draws cartoons, especially for newspapers or magazines.

words.ex: He asked for clarification about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他要求对规则进行澄清。
words.en: A clarification is a statement that makes something clear or easier to understand.

words.ex: The clown made the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 小丑让孩子们笑了。
words.en: A clown is a performer, typically in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup, and entertains by performing comedic acts.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.ex: The doctor improved cross-talk between the nurses and patients.
words.ex_cn: 医生改善了护士与患者之间的相互沟通。
words.en: Cross-talk refers to the interference or unwanted signal that occurs in telecommunications or electronics, where a signal from one circuit or channel interferes with another. It can also refer to a form of Chinese comedic performance involving rapid dialogue.

words.tr: phrase. 双关语；具有双重含义（尤其是含蓄淫秽含义）的词语或表达
words.ex: He used a double entendre to make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他用了双关语让大家笑了。
words.en: A double entendre is a phrase or figure of speech that could have two meanings or that could be understood in two different ways.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.ex: His familiarity with the city helped him find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他对这座城市的熟悉帮助他找到了路。
words.en: A thorough knowledge or mastery of a subject, place, or situation, often gained through experience.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 祖母；外祖母；奶奶；外婆
words.ex: My grandma cooks soup every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶每个星期天都煮汤。
words.en: Your grandma is your grandmother. In other words, your grandma is your mother or father's mother.

words.tr: n. 幽默作家；富于幽默感的人
words.ex: He is a famous humorist who makes people laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的幽默作家，让人们发笑。
words.en: A humorist is someone who writes or tells funny stories or jokes.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏幽默感的，非常严肃的，一本正经的
words.ex: He is humorless and never smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他很无趣，从不笑。
words.en: If you say that someone is humorless, you mean that they are very serious about everything and do not find things amusing.

words.ex: He tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一些幽默的故事，让大家都笑。
words.en: If you are humorous, you are able to be amusing and to make people laugh.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.tr: adj. 恼怒的；生气的； v. “irritate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was irritated by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那阵噪音惹恼了。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.ex: His excuse was laughable.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口可笑极了。
words.en: If you describe something as laughable, you mean that it is so silly or unreasonable that you can only laugh at it.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.tr: v. 腾跃；阔步行走；神气地快速走动
words.ex: The horse prances across the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹马在田野上欢快地跳跃。
words.en: If a horse prances, it moves with high, springy steps.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.tr:
n. 双关语
v. 说双关语
words.ex: He made a bad pun and everyone groaned.
words.ex_cn: 他开了个蹩脚的玩笑，大家都皱起了眉头。
words.en: A pun is a clever and amusing use of a word or phrase with two meanings, or of words with the same sound but different meanings.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.ex: The riddler asks a hard question.
words.ex_cn: 谜语人问了一个难题。
words.en: A person who poses riddles or puzzles, often in a challenging or mysterious manner.

words.ex: He selectively picks the easiest questions to answer.
words.ex_cn: 他有选择地挑最容易的问题来回答。
words.en: In a manner that involves choosing carefully and thoughtfully.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.tr: n. 计划；组织；机构；装配
words.ex: The set-up for the party was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 派对的计划很完美。
words.en: The way in which something, especially an organization or equipment, is organized, planned, or arranged.

words.ex: He likes slapstick comedy because it makes him laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢滑稽喜剧，因为它让他大笑。
words.en: Slapstick is a type of physical comedy characterized by broad humor, absurd situations, and vigorous, usually violent action.

words.tr:
adj. 闪光的；闪烁的；起泡的
v. 闪光；焕发活力；“sparkle”的现在分词
words.ex: The sparkling diamond caught the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 闪亮的钻石吸引了阳光。
words.en: Something that is sparkling shines with a lot of small points of light.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr: adj. 暗示的；影射的；性暗示的
words.ex: His look was suggestive of sadness.
words.ex_cn: 他的眼神暗示着悲伤。
words.en: Something that is suggestive of something else is likely to make you think about or remember it.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.tr: adj. 庸俗的；粗俗的；粗野的；下流的
words.ex: He used a vulgar word in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上说了一个粗俗的词。
words.en: If you describe something as vulgar, you mean that it is in bad taste or of poor quality.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人的能力范围；在某人够不到的地方
words.ex: The book is beyond the reach of the boy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书那个男孩够不着。
words.en: If something is beyond the reach of somebody, it is too difficult or expensive for them to achieve or obtain.

words.tr: phrase. 爱上某人；对某人产生爱情
words.ex: He falls in love with somebody at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校爱上了某人。
words.en: To develop a strong romantic attachment to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 露出一个微笑，突然笑一下
words.ex: He flash a smile when he saw his friend.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到朋友时，他露出一个微笑。
words.en: To smile quickly and briefly.

words.w: make an attempt to do something
words.tr: phrase. 尝试做某事；试图做某事
words.uk: meɪk ən əˈtempt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ən əˈtempt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He will make an attempt to climb the mountain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将尝试攀登那座山。
words.en: To try or endeavor to perform a specific action.

chapters.name: Unit 1 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.tr: n. 贵族政治；贵族统治；贵族
words.ex: The aristocracy lived in big castles long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，贵族住在巨大的城堡里。
words.en: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.ex: The old clock has a broken clockwork.
words.ex_cn: 这台老钟的钟表装置坏了。
words.en: A clockwork is a mechanism that operates in a very precise and regular way, often used in toys or small machines.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The small room was cosy with a warm blanket and a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间铺着温暖的毯子，喝着热茶，非常舒适。
words.en: A place or situation that is cosy is comfortable and warm.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 过时的；陈旧的；
words.ex: This coin is dated to the year 1500.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币追溯到1500年。
words.en: Something that is dated is old-fashioned and no longer relevant or useful.

words.ex: The detection of smoke triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾的探测触发了警报。
words.en: The act of detecting something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: The story is fictional and not based on real events.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是虚构的，不是基于真实事件。
words.en: Fictional refers to something that is invented or imagined, and not necessarily based on real events or people.

words.ex: The gardener waters the plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 园丁每天早上给植物浇水。
words.en: A gardener is someone who takes care of a garden as a job or hobby.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.tr: n. 流产；早产；误投；失败
words.ex: She had a miscarriage last month.
words.ex_cn: 她上个月流产了。
words.en: A miscarriage is the premature expulsion of a fetus from the womb before it is able to survive independently, or a failure to achieve the intended result of a plan or action.

words.ex: He refused the money, because morally it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了那笔钱，因为道义上这是不对的。
words.en: In a manner relating to principles of right and wrong behavior.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.tr: v. 使心神不宁；使不安；扰乱
words.ex: The loud noise unsettled the baby.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让婴儿不安。
words.en: To make someone feel anxious or uncertain.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.tr: n. 侦探小说，惊险刺激读物
words.ex: He loves reading whodunit novels at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上读侦探小说。
words.en: A whodunit is a novel, play, or film which deals with a crime, usually a murder, and which keeps the identity of the criminal secret until the end.

words.tr: n. 凶杀悬疑小说（或电影、戏剧）
words.ex: He loves reading whodunnit novels at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上读推理小说。
words.en: A whodunnit is a novel, play, or film which deals with a crime, usually murder, and which includes a character who acts as a detective, trying to solve the mystery of who committed the crime.

words.tr: n. <非正式>犯罪动机小说（影片等）
words.ex: He read a whydunit to guess the killer's motive.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本推理小说来猜测凶手的动机。
words.en: A mystery novel or film that focuses on revealing the motives behind a crime rather than the identity of the perpetrator.

words.ex: He wrongly answered the question.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地回答了这个问题。
words.en: Incorrectly or unjustly.

chapters.name: Unit 1 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The story ends with a happy surprise.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事以一个快乐的惊喜结束。
words.en: To finish or conclude in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 极有规律地；精确无误地；按部就班地
words.ex: The train runs like clockwork every morning.
words.ex_cn: 火车每天早上都像钟表一样准时运行。
words.en: If something happens like clockwork, it happens exactly as planned or expected, without any problems or delays.

words.tr: phrase. 未了结的零星事务；悬而未决的细节；未完成的环节
words.ex: He tied up the loose end before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前解决了那个未完成的小问题。
words.en: A loose end is a small detail or problem that remains to be settled or resolved.

words.tr: phrase. 未了结的零碎事项；悬而未决的细节
words.ex: He tied up all the loose ends before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前解决了所有未完成的事情。
words.en: Unfinished details or unresolved matters.

words.tr: phrase. 误判；司法不公；审判错误
words.ex: The court admitted a miscarriage of justice after the innocent man was freed.
words.ex_cn: 法院在无辜男子被释放后承认了司法不公。
words.en: A miscarriage of justice occurs when a person is wrongly convicted of a crime.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is without doubt the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is definitely true or will definitely happen

words.tr: phrase. 被逮捕的；处于拘捕状态的
words.ex: The man is under arrest for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人因偷窃被逮捕了。
words.en: If someone is under arrest, they have been arrested by the police and are being held in custody.

chapters.name: Unit 1 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: The tree has bare branches in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在冬天有光秃秃的树枝。
words.en: If part of your body is bare, it is not covered by any clothing.

words.tr: n. 保龄球； v. “bowl”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves playing bowling on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末打保龄球。
words.en: Bowling is a game in which you roll a heavy ball down a long, narrow track towards a group of wooden objects called pins, trying to knock down as many of them as possible.

words.ex: A cascade of complaints flooded the office.
words.ex_cn: 大量投诉涌进了办公室。
words.en: A cascade is a small waterfall or a series of small waterfalls. As a verb, it means to flow or fall in or like a cascade.

words.ex: He danced crazily at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上疯狂地跳舞。
words.en: In a manner that is wildly excited or enthusiastic.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr: n. 表演者；艺人；款待的人
words.ex: The entertainer sang and danced for the children.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者为孩子们唱歌跳舞。
words.en: An entertainer is a person whose job is to amuse or interest people, for example by telling jokes, singing, or dancing.

words.ex: He hastened to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他赶紧在晚饭前写完作业。
words.en: If you hasten to do something, you quickly do it or quickly go somewhere.

words.ex: He is hooked on video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If you are hooked on something, you enjoy it so much that it takes up a lot of your interest and attention.

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.ex: My mom makes breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A mother; a female parent.

words.ex: He wears shorts to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他穿短裤去海滩。
words.en: Shorts are a piece of clothing that you wear on the lower part of your body, which do not cover your legs completely.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.ex: He tosses the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To throw something, especially something light, with a quick, light motion.

words.ex: He rides a unicycle in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他骑着独轮车在公园里。
words.en: A unicycle is a vehicle that has only one wheel and is usually ridden for entertainment or sport.

words.ex: He wanted vengeance after his brother was hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他哥哥被伤害后，他想要报复。
words.en: Vengeance is the act of doing something harmful or unpleasant to someone because they have done something harmful or unpleasant to you.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

chapters.name: Unit 1 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He decided to back out of the deal.
words.ex_cn: 他决定退出这笔交易。
words.en: If someone backs out of an agreement or a deal, they decide not to continue with it.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 重新开始；从头再来
words.ex: He decides to start over after failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后决定从头再来。
words.en: To begin again or anew.

words.tr: phrase. 试用某物；试验某事物
words.ex: He tries the new app out to see if it works well.
words.ex_cn: 他试用这个新应用程序，看看它是否好用。
words.en: To test something to see if it is effective or suitable.

words.ex: He missed the bus, and he was late with a vengeance.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了公交车，结果迟到了很多。
words.en: If you do something with a vengeance, you do it with great intensity or force, often more than expected or usual.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Part Two New Words

words.tr:
adj. 疏远的；冷淡的
adv. 远离地
words.ex: He stayed aloof during the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上保持冷淡。
words.en: Someone who is aloof is not very friendly and does not like to spend time with other people.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr:
adj. 热诚的；友好的
n. 甜露酒
words.ex: He gave a cordial smile to his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他对着邻居露出了热情的微笑。
words.en: warm and friendly

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: The freshness of the fruit made it delicious.
words.ex_cn: 水果的新鲜让它很好吃。
words.en: The quality of being fresh; newness or recentness; the state of being free from staleness, mustiness, or decay.

words.ex: His smile seemed insincere.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑显得不真心。
words.en: If you say that someone is insincere, you are being critical of them because they say things they do not really mean, usually pleasant, admiring, or encouraging things.

words.tr: adj. 鼓舞的；激励的； v. 鼓舞；激励；“inspire”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her speech was inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲是鼓舞人心的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inspiring, you mean that they make you feel that you want to do something, especially something new or creative.

words.tr:
v. 密谋；激起…的兴趣
n. 阴谋诡计；密谋策划
words.ex: They intrigue to take over the company.
words.ex_cn: 他们密谋接管这家公司。
words.en: If something intrigues you, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.ex: He calls his parents every week using long-distance phone service.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都用长途电话服务给父母打电话。
words.en: Involving or covering a long distance.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: He wrote a memo to remind the team.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一封备忘录提醒团队。
words.en: A memo is a short official note that is sent by one person to another within the same company or organization.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: Graduating from high school was a big milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 从高中毕业对他来说是一个重要的事件。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr: n. 实践者；从业者；执业者；
words.ex: He is a medical practitioner who helps patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天帮助病人的医疗实践者。
words.en: A practitioner is someone who works in a particular profession, especially one that requires special training and skills.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr: adj. 卷边的; 折角的; 翻旧了的
words.ex: The rag-eared dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 那只耳朵破烂的狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: Worn or shabby from overuse, especially of the corners of the pages of a book.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.ex: He reread the book to understand it better.
words.ex_cn: 他重新读了这本书，以便更好地理解。
words.en: To read (something) again.

words.tr:
v. 品味；细品；享用；体会
n. 风味；滋味
words.ex: He savord the taste of the chocolate slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地品味着巧克力的味道。
words.en: To enjoy or appreciate (something) completely.

words.tr:
v. 潦草地写；匆匆地写；乱涂乱画
n. 潦草的字迹；涂鸦
words.ex: He scribbled his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上潦草地写了名字。
words.en: To scribble means to write or draw something quickly or carelessly.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.tr: adj．振奋精神的，令人振奋的：能够提振人的精神，使人感到愉快、充满活力的。
words.ex: The sunny day was spirit-lifting after weeks of rain.
words.ex_cn: 在连续几周的下雨之后，晴朗的日子让人心情振奋。
words.en: Something that is spirit-lifting makes you feel more cheerful and optimistic.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.tr: adj. 没有回应的；漠不关心的；没反应的
words.ex: The phone is unresponsive after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 手机摔了之后没反应了。
words.en: If someone is unresponsive, they do not react or respond to something such as an action, a question, or a new idea.

words.ex: He is upbeat about his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他对新工作感到乐观。
words.en: If people or their opinions are upbeat, they are cheerful and full of hope.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: He gave her a card with well-wishing words.
words.ex_cn: 他送给她一张写满祝福话语的卡片。
words.en: Expressing good wishes for someone's happiness and success.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 一种表扬或鼓励的方式，表示赞许或认可
words.ex: He gave her a pat on the back for doing well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为她的出色表现给了她一个鼓励的拍背。
words.en: An expression of praise or congratulations for doing something well.

words.ex: He attaches importance to homework.
words.ex_cn: 他重视家庭作业。
words.en: To consider something as important or to give special attention to it.

words.tr: phrase. 正在发现某种重要的事情；可能发现了有价值的想法或机会
words.ex: He is on to something important.
words.ex_cn: 他发现了一些重要的东西。
words.en: If you are on to something, you have discovered or realized something that is significant or interesting.

words.tr:
n. 后续工作；后续事物
adj. 后续的；接着的
words.ex: He made a follow-up call to check on his patient.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一个随访电话来检查病人的状况。
words.en: An action or thing that serves to increase the effectiveness of a previous one, especially a second letter, phone call, or visit.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；抬起；鼓舞；使振奋
words.ex: He lift up the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手把箱子举起来。
words.en: to raise something or someone to a higher position or level

words.tr: phrase. 使…成为习惯；养成…的习惯
words.ex: He makes a habit of brushing his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他养成了每天早上刷牙的习惯。
words.en: To make a habit of something means to do it regularly or often, so that it becomes a usual thing for you to do.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人一天都很开心；让某人一天都充满喜悦
words.ex: A simple 'thank you' can make somebody's day.
words.ex_cn: 一句简单的“谢谢”就能让某人开心一整天。
words.en: To make someone very happy.

words.tr: phrase. 传递；转交；转告；沿…继续前进
words.ex: Please pass along the message to your brother.
words.ex_cn: 请把消息转告给你弟弟。
words.en: To convey or transmit something from one person to another.

words.tr: phrase. 回避；畏缩不前；不敢面对
words.ex: He shy away from speaking in front of people.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在众人面前说话。
words.en: If you shy away from doing something, you avoid doing it, often because you are afraid or not confident enough.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.tr: phrase. 转身；（使）好转；（使）扭转局面
words.ex: He heard a noise and told me to turn around.
words.ex_cn: 他听到一声响动，叫我转过身来。
words.en: To change direction so as to face the opposite way; to change something bad into something good.

words.tr: phrase. 社会阶层；职业；人生境遇（泛指各种不同背景或职业的人）
words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各个社会阶层的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: The term 'walk of life' refers to a person's occupation or position within society, indicating the diverse backgrounds or professions people come from.

chapters.name: Unit 2 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: He put his money in the billfold.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱放进了钱包。
words.en: A billfold is a small, flat case that is used for carrying paper money, cards, and other small personal items.

words.ex: He blurted out the secret by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心说出了秘密。
words.en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

words.ex: He saw a wooden coffin at the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他在葬礼上看到一个木制棺材。
words.en: A coffin is a box in which a dead body is buried or cremated.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；令人高兴的
words.ex: The garden is delightful in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，这个花园令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is delightful is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.

words.ex: He got edgy when the train was late.
words.ex_cn: 当火车晚点时，他变得急躁了。
words.en: If someone is edgy, they are nervous and anxious, and likely to become easily upset or angry.

words.ex: The old farmhouse stands near the field.
words.ex_cn: 那座古老的农舍坐落在田地附近。
words.en: A farmhouse is a house attached to a farm, especially the main house in which the farmer lives.

words.ex: He is tapping his pen incessantly.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地敲打钢笔。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: The child's mischievousness made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的顽皮让大家都笑了。
words.en: Mischievousness refers to the quality of being fond of causing trouble in a playful way.

words.ex: He is a novice at playing the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是个吉他新手。
words.en: A novice is someone who has just started learning or doing something and does not have much experience.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.ex: He wore a ragged coat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿着一件破旧的外套。
words.en: Clothes that are ragged are old and torn.

words.ex: He refolded the letter carefully before putting it in the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地重新折好信，然后放进信封里。
words.en: To fold something again.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The serviceman returned home after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名军人在战争结束后回到了家。
words.en: A serviceman is a man who is a member of the armed forces.

words.tr:
n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
words.ex: He shrugged when asked why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到为什么迟到时，他耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.tr:
v. 眨眼；使眼色；闪烁
n. 眨眼；眼色；瞬间
words.ex: He winked at me to show he was joking.
words.ex_cn: 他朝我眨了眨眼，表示他在开玩笑。
words.en: If you wink at someone, you look towards them and close one eye very briefly, usually as a signal that something is a joke or a secret.

chapters.name: Unit 2 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.tr: phrase. v. 脱口说出；冲口说出（通常指未经思考地说出）
words.ex: He blurted out the answer before the teacher finished the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师还没问完问题，他就脱口说出了答案。
words.en: If someone blurts something out, they say it suddenly, without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 失去控制；变得难以管理
words.ex: The party got out of hand when too many people came.
words.ex_cn: 当来的人太多时，聚会失控了。
words.en: If a situation or person gets out of hand, they become difficult to control.

words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.tr: phrase. 理解；解释；看待；把……当作
words.ex: What do you make of this picture?
words.ex_cn: 你觉得这幅画怎么样？
words.en: To understand, interpret, or form an opinion about something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.tr: phrase. 屡次之后终于出事；次数太多以至于自食其果
words.ex: He broke the rule once too often.
words.ex_cn: 他违反规则次数太多了。
words.en: If something happens once too often, it happens again and this time the result is not good because people are no longer willing to accept it.

words.tr: phrase. 撕下；匆匆完成；跑掉
words.ex: He tore off the label from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子上的标签撕掉了。
words.en: To remove something by pulling it roughly or violently.

words.ex: He remembers his first teacher to this day.
words.ex_cn: 直到今天，他仍然记得他的第一位老师。
words.en: Until the present time; still.

chapters.name: Unit 2 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr: adj. 依…而定的；附带条件的；
words.ex: The prize is conditional on winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品取决于是否赢得比赛。
words.en: A conditional action or agreement depends on something else happening or being done.

words.ex: He tried to disprove the theory with new data.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用新数据驳斥这个理论。
words.en: To disprove something means to show that it is not true or correct.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.ex: Her expressive eyes showed all her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她富有表情的眼睛展现了她所有的感情。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as expressive, you mean that their behaviour clearly indicates their feelings or intentions.

words.ex: The sentence has a grammatical error.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个语法错误。
words.en: Relating to grammar or the rules of grammar.

words.ex: He spoke in the guise of a friend.
words.ex_cn: 他以朋友的伪装说话。
words.en: An external form, appearance, or manner of presentation, typically concealing the true nature of something.

words.ex: The poem uses vivid imagery to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗用生动的意象来描述日落。
words.en: Imagery consists of the elements in a poem or other literary work that appeal to the senses, especially sight.

words.ex: The painting is imperfect but full of feeling.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画不完美，但充满情感。
words.en: If something is imperfect, it has faults or is not complete.

words.tr: adv. 有缺点地；不完美地；未完成地
words.ex: He painted the wall imperfectly.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙刷得不完美。
words.en: In a way that is not perfect or has faults.

words.ex: They share intimacy through quiet talks at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过夜晚的安静交谈建立亲密感。
words.en: A close, familiar, and usually affectionate or loving personal relationship with another person or group.

words.tr: v. 使转变为名词，使名词化
words.ex: They nominalize the word 'happy' to 'happiness'.
words.ex_cn: 他们把'happy'这个单词名词化为'happiness'。
words.en: To convert into or use as a noun.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: He showed his portfolio to the art teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向美术老师展示了他作品集。
words.en: A portfolio is a set of pictures by someone, or photographs of examples of their work, which they use when entering competitions or applying for work.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. premedical 医学院预科的
words.ex: He is taking pre-med courses to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上预科医学课程，以成为一名医生。
words.en: Relating to the period of study undertaken by a student before entering medical school.

words.ex: The rebellious boy refused to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个叛逆的男孩拒绝遵守规则。
words.en: If you think someone is rebellious, you mean that they are deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr: adv. 极大地；值得注目地；
words.ex: The new policy significantly improved student performance.
words.ex_cn: 新政策极大地改善了学生的成绩。
words.en: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The sociological impact of the event was profound.
words.ex_cn: 这一事件的社会学影响是深远的。
words.en: Relating to the study of the development, structure, and functioning of human society.

words.tr: n. 稳健；坚固性；健全；公正
words.ex: The soundness of the structure was questioned by the engineers.
words.ex_cn: 工程师们对该结构的稳固性提出了质疑。
words.en: The quality or state of being sound; especially, the state of being free from defect, decay, or damage; firmness; solidity; validity.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.ex: He works as a stockbroker in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约做股票经纪人。
words.en: A stockbroker is a person whose job is to buy and sell stocks and shares for other people.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: I can't tolerate loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法容忍巨大的噪音。
words.en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: The concept of wholeness in traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes the balance of body and mind.
words.ex_cn: 中医中的完整性概念强调身体和心灵的平衡。
words.en: The state of being whole or complete; the quality of being unbroken or undamaged.

words.tr:
v. 叫喊
n. 喊叫
words.ex: He yells when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会大喊。
words.en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.

chapters.name: Unit 2 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 认真对待某人；重视某人的意见或感受
words.ex: You should take someone seriously when they talk about their problems.
words.ex_cn: 当别人谈论他们的困难时，你应该认真对待。
words.en: To treat someone or their opinions with respect and attention, believing that they are important or worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 认真对待某事；严肃看待某物
words.ex: You should take your health seriously.
words.ex_cn: 你应该认真对待你的健康。
words.en: To consider something to be important and worth your attention and respect.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Part Two New Words

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr: adj. 有偏见的； v. “bias”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The judge was biased against the defendant.
words.ex_cn: 这位法官对被告有偏见。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr: adj. 性别偏见的；性别偏向的
words.ex: The job hiring is sex-biased, favoring men.
words.ex_cn: 招聘有性别偏见，偏向男性。
words.en: Showing a preference or prejudice based on someone's sex.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.tr: adv. 从文化角度；文化意义上；
words.ex: They treat each other culturally with respect.
words.ex_cn: 他们从文化角度彼此尊重。
words.en: In a way that relates to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: He helped indirectly by giving advice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提供建议间接地帮忙了。
words.en: In a way that is not direct; not in a straight line or course.

words.ex: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有数不清的星星。
words.en: Too many to be counted; very many.

words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.ex: He values neatness in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他重视作业的整洁。
words.en: The quality or condition of being neat; tidiness.

words.ex: The ghost is nonexistent.
words.ex_cn: 这个幽灵是不存在的。
words.en: If you say that something is nonexistent, you mean that it does not exist when you feel that it should.

words.ex: He lives in the northeastern part of China.
words.ex_cn: 他住在中国的东北部。
words.en: Situated in or oriented toward the northeast.

words.tr: adv. 明显地；引人注目地；
words.ex: He is noticeably taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥明显高得多。
words.en: In a way that is easily seen or noticed; clearly.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: The preschooler plays with blocks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个学龄前儿童每天早上都玩积木。
words.en: A preschooler is a child who is old enough to go to preschool but has not yet started school.

words.tr: n. 放置在次级；次级；附属
words.ex: He accepted the subordination to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了对老板的服从。
words.en: The act of placing in a lower rank or position; the state of being subordinated.

words.tr: adj. 无意的；非故意的；无意识的；
words.ex: He made an unintentional mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了一个无意的错误。
words.en: If something is unintentional, it is done without being planned or intended.

words.tr: adv. 无意中地；不知不觉地
words.ex: He unknowingly broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中违反了规则。
words.en: Without being aware of or intending to do something.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.ex: We can carry over the unused vacation days to next year.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把未用完的假期天数延到明年。
words.en: To transfer or extend something from one time or place to another.

words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrase. 把…收起来；把…放回原处；储存；吃掉；把…关进监狱
words.ex: Please put your toys away after playing.
words.ex_cn: 玩完玩具后请把它们收好。
words.en: To place something in its proper location for storage; to save or store something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

chapters.name: Unit 3 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He looked at the lie with contempt.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you have contempt for someone or something, you have no respect for them or think that they are unimportant.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: He is hopeful about passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己通过考试抱有希望。
words.en: If you are hopeful, you are fairly confident that something that you want to happen will happen.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: The smell of bread pervades the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫在整个厨房里。
words.en: If something pervades a place or thing, it is present throughout it.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；正当的；正义的
words.ex: She claimed her rightful inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 她要求得到她合法的继承权。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has a rightful place or position, you mean that they deserve that place or position.

words.tr: adj. 邋遢的；随便的；草率的；马虎的；泥泞的；宽松肥大的；多阴雨的；感情脆弱的
words.ex: He gave a sloppy answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个马虎的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone's work or activities as sloppy, you mean that they have been done in a careless and lazy way.

words.ex: She shouted in an unladylike way.
words.ex_cn: 她以一种不符合淑女风范的方式大喊。
words.en: If you say that a woman or her behavior is unladylike, you mean that she does not behave in a way traditionally thought to be socially acceptable for a woman.

chapters.name: Unit 3 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 处于不利地位；处于劣势
words.ex: He is at a disadvantage because he doesn't speak English well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为英语说不好而处于劣势。
words.en: If you are at a disadvantage, you are in a situation in which you are less likely to succeed than others because of something that makes it harder for you to compete.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于某事的；对某事感到惯常的
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯了早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are familiar with it and you accept it as normal or usual.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于做某事的；对做某事感到习以为常的
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯每天早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are familiar with it and you accept it as normal or usual.

words.tr: 短语动词. 属于少数派；占少数
words.ex: He is in a minority because he likes math more than sports.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学胜过运动，所以是少数派。
words.en: To be part of a small group within a larger group that holds a different opinion or is different in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 典型的；有代表性的
words.ex: This behavior is typical of children his age.
words.ex_cn: 这种行为是他这个年龄的孩子典型的。
words.en: If something is typical of a particular type of thing, it has the usual qualities or features of that type.

words.tr: phrase. 被烧死；因燃烧而死亡
words.ex: The man burned to death in the house fire.
words.ex_cn: 那名男子在房屋火灾中被烧死。
words.en: To die as a result of being burned.

words.tr: phrase. 被活活烧死；被烧致死
words.ex: The man was burnt to death in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那个人在火灾中被烧死了。
words.en: To die as a result of being severely burned.

words.ex: I've been waiting for ages!
words.ex_cn: 我已经等了很久了！
words.en: For a very long time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 走得太远；做得过分
words.ex: He went too far when he broke his sister's toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他弄坏他妹妹的玩具时，他做得太过分了。
words.en: To go beyond what is reasonable or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 把…当回事；小题大做；过分强调
words.ex: He makes a thing of forgetting his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他总把忘带钥匙当回事。
words.en: To treat something as more important or significant than it really is, often causing unnecessary attention or fuss.

chapters.name: Unit 3 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: She sang softly to allay his fears.
words.ex_cn: 她轻声唱歌以缓解他的恐惧。
words.en: If you allay someone's fears or doubts, you stop them feeling afraid or doubtful.

words.ex: The amniotic fluid provides a protective environment for the developing fetus.
words.ex_cn: 羊水为正在发育的胎儿提供了一个保护环境。
words.en: Relating to the amnion or the amniotic fluid.

words.ex: His argument is based on anecdotal evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点基于轶事证据。
words.en: Anecdotal evidence is based on personal accounts rather than on research that can be verified.

words.tr: adj. 平衡的； v. （使）平衡；“balance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She eats a balanced diet to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她吃均衡的饮食以保持健康。
words.en: If something is balanced, it has equal proportions or is arranged in a way that is not too much in one direction or another.

words.ex: The constructional design of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的构造设计非常坚固。
words.en: Relating to the construction or structure of something.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The weather is a determinant of whether we go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 天气是我们是否去远足的决定因素。
words.en: A determinant is a factor which decisively affects the nature or outcome of something.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: abbr. 自己动手做（Do It Yourself）；
words.ex: He made a bookshelf by himself using diy tools.
words.ex_cn: 他用自己动手做的工具做了一个书架。
words.en: DIY is the activity of making or repairing things yourself, especially in your home, rather than paying someone else to do it.

words.tr: v. 移情；神会；有同感；产生共鸣
words.ex: She tries to empathize with her friend's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她努力理解朋友的感受。
words.en: If you empathize with someone, you understand their situation, problems, and feelings, because you have been in a similar situation.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: His fear of heights is hard-wired from birth.
words.ex_cn: 他对高度的恐惧是与生俱来的。
words.en: If something is hard-wired into a computer or machine, it is built into it and cannot be changed. If a quality or way of behaving is hard-wired into a person or animal, it is a natural part of them that they cannot change.

words.ex: He bought a new hi-fi system for his home.
words.ex_cn: 他为家里买了一套新的高保真音响设备。
words.en: High-fidelity sound reproduction, especially in audio equipment.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: I bought a newspaper from the newsagent.
words.ex_cn: 我从报刊亭买了一份报纸。
words.en: A newsagent is a person or shop that sells newspapers and magazines.

words.ex: He walked onwards without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地向前走。
words.en: If something happens from a particular time onwards or onward, it begins to happen at that time and continues to happen afterward.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.ex: Good parenting helps children grow happily.
words.ex_cn: 良好的育儿有助于孩子快乐成长。
words.en: Parenting is the activity of bringing up and looking after children.

words.ex: The city is predominantly populated by young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市主要由年轻人居住。
words.en: If something is predominantly true, it is true to a much greater extent than it is false.

words.ex: Prenatal care is crucial for the health of both the mother and the baby.
words.ex_cn: 产前护理对母亲和婴儿的健康至关重要。
words.en: Prenatal means relating to the medical care given to pregnant women before their babies are born.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The ram broke down the wooden door.
words.ex_cn: 撞击装置撞碎了木门。
words.en: A ram is an adult male sheep. As a verb, it means to force something into a place or to hit something with great force.

words.tr: adj. 以自我为中心的；自私的
words.ex: He is self-centered and never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 他以自我为中心，从不听别人的话。
words.en: Someone who is self-centered is only concerned with their own needs and interests and does not consider the needs or wishes of other people.

words.ex: Children learn socialization through playing with others.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过与其他孩子玩耍来学习社交。
words.en: The process by which individuals learn and adopt the behaviors and norms of their society or group.

words.ex: He tries to systemize his notes every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都试图整理他的笔记。
words.en: To arrange according to a system; make systematic.

words.ex: He has high testosterone levels.
words.ex_cn: 他的睾酮水平很高。
words.en: Testosterone is a steroid hormone that stimulates development of male secondary sexual characteristics, produced mainly in the testes, but also in the ovaries and adrenal cortex.

words.tr: n. 学步的小孩；幼童装（toddler 的变形）
words.ex: He was very active in toddlerhood.
words.ex_cn: 他在幼儿时期非常活泼。
words.en: The period in a person's life when they are a toddler, typically between the ages of one and three.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

chapters.name: Unit 3 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 他送给她一束花。
words.en: A large number or quantity of something.

words.ex: He goes beyond what the teacher asks.
words.ex_cn: 他做得比老师要求的更多。
words.en: To exceed or surpass a certain limit or expectation.

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 组成整体；装配；组合
words.ex: He put together a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他做了个三明治当午餐。
words.en: To assemble or compile various parts or elements into a whole.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Part Two New Words

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The educator helps students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这位教育者帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An educator is a person who educates people, especially as a job.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.ex: This plan is workable and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且便宜。
words.en: If something is workable, it can be done, used, or put into operation successfully.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 由…决定；是…的职责；从事；胜任
words.ex_cn: 这个周末你打算做什么？
words.en: Used to ask or talk about what someone is doing or planning to do.

words.tr: phrase. 使参与；使卷入；使陷入；使牵涉其中
words.ex: The teacher involves the students in the math game.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与数学游戏。
words.en: To include someone or something as part of an activity or situation.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

chapters.name: Unit 4 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.tr: adv. 笨拙地；局促不安地；尴尬地
words.ex: He walked awkwardly after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路很不自然。
words.en: In a manner that is not graceful or elegant in movement or shape; clumsily.

words.ex: The surgeon's dexterity saved the patient's life.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生的灵巧救了病人的命。
words.en: Skill and grace in physical movement, especially in the use of the hands; adroitness.

words.ex: The children waited expectantly for the gifts.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们期待地等待着礼物。
words.en: In a way that shows you are hoping for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.ex: He did an exploratory trip to find new places.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了一次探索性的旅行来寻找新地方。
words.en: relating to or involving exploration or investigation

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: The teacher made an intervention to help the student.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了干预以帮助学生。
words.en: Intervention is the act of intervening, especially in a situation to prevent something undesirable from happening.

words.ex: His intrusive questions made her uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他打搅的问题让她感到不舒服。
words.en: Something that is intrusive disturbs your privacy or peace in an unwanted way.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: A passer-by helped the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人帮老人过马路。
words.en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past something, especially when something unusual is happening.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: v. 重新定位；使适应；改变方针；调整
words.ex: He had to reorient his goals after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后不得不重新调整自己的目标。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.tr: n. 衬衣下（后）摆，社论栏 adj. 幼小的，远房的
words.ex: He tucked his shirttail into his pants.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫下摆塞进裤子里。
words.en: The lower part of a shirt that hangs below the waist, or something that is relatively minor or less important.

words.ex: The coin fell into the slot.
words.ex_cn: 硬币掉进了狭槽里。
words.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

words.ex: Children learn socialization through playing with others.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过与其他孩子玩耍来学习社交。
words.en: The process by which individuals learn and adopt the behaviors and norms of their society or group.

words.tr: n. 散步者；流浪者；婴儿推车
words.ex: The old man takes a walk every morning as a stroller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人每天早上都以散步者的身份散步。
words.en: A stroller is a small chair on wheels, in which a baby or young child can sit and be wheeled around.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: He shook the bottle vigorously.
words.ex_cn: 他有力地摇晃了瓶子。
words.en: If you do something vigorously, you do it with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: n. 西方人；西欧人；（美国的）西部人
words.ex: The westerner tried dumplings for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这位西方人第一次尝试了饺子。
words.en: A person from the western part of a country or the Western world.

chapters.name: Unit 4 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.ex: He was not in the least worried about the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他一点也不担心考试。
words.en: Not at all; not in any way or degree.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents on occasion.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Sometimes but not often.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；屡次；反复地
words.ex: He makes the same mistake time and again.
words.ex_cn: 他一次又一次地犯同样的错误。
words.en: If something happens time and again, it happens repeatedly.

chapters.name: Unit 4 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: He told an anecdote about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的趣事。
words.en: An anecdote is a short, amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.tr: adj. 形成鲜明对比的；相反的； v. 和...形成对照；对比；“contrast”的现在分词；
words.ex: The black and white shirts are contrasting colors.
words.ex_cn: 黑色和白色的衬衫是形成鲜明对比的颜色。
words.en: Showing a noticeable difference when compared.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: He could discern a small bird in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 他能辨明树上有一只小鸟。
words.en: If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is.

words.tr:
n. 连枷
v. 用连枷打；胡乱摆动；用力地挥动
words.ex: The farmer flails the wheat to separate the grains.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用连枷打小麦以分离谷粒。
words.en: A flail is a tool used for threshing grain, consisting of a long handle with a freely swinging stick or bar attached to it. As a verb, to flail means to wave or swing wildly; to thrash about.

words.tr:
n. 刚长齐羽毛学飞的幼鸟
adj. 新形成的；无经验的
v. 羽毛长成；用羽毛盖上；装上羽毛；“fledge”的现在分词
words.ex: The fledgling bird tried to fly for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这只幼鸟第一次尝试飞翔。
words.en: A fledgling is a young bird that has just grown its feathers and is learning to fly. It can also refer to a person or organization that is new and inexperienced.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The children gave a mimetic performance of the animals.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们表演了模仿动物的节目。
words.en: Mimetic refers to the ability or tendency to mimic or imitate.

words.ex: The boy was punished for his misdeed.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因他的恶劣行为而受到惩罚。
words.en: A misdeed is a wrong or illegal deed; a crime or sin.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.tr:
n. 回想
v. 回想
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回顾过去，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.ex: The rooster crows every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡每天早上打鸣。
words.en: A rooster is an adult male chicken.

words.tr: n. 自立；依靠自己；自力更生
words.ex: He learns self-reliance from living alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自生活学会自立。
words.en: Self-reliance is the ability to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

words.ex: The bright lights caused stimulation in her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的灯光引起了她眼睛的刺激。
words.en: The act of arousing or accelerating physiological or psychological activity or response in an organism or any of its parts.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: He listened sympathetically to her story.
words.ex_cn: 他同情地听她讲了自己的故事。
words.en: In a way that shows you understand and care about someone's suffering or problems.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.tr: adj. 无争议的；公认的；无疑问的
words.ex: His authority is unquestioned by everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的权威被所有人无条件认可。
words.en: If something is unquestioned, it is accepted without any doubt or disagreement.

chapters.name: Unit 4 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着…的希望；期望…；希望…
words.ex: He studies hard in the hope that he will pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，希望能通过考试。
words.en: with the wish or expectation that something will happen

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr: phrase. 切题；切中要害；中肯；扼要
words.ex: His answer was to the point.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答切中要点。
words.en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as to the point, you approve of it because it is relevant to the subject and does not contain anything unnecessary.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part Two New Words

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.tr:
adj. 限制的
v. 限制；“confine”的现在分词
words.ex: The rules are confining and make me feel trapped.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则很束缚人，让我感觉像被困住一样。
words.en: If something is confining, it restricts or limits your freedom or ability to move.

words.tr:
v. 泡一泡；浸一下；扣篮
n. 灌篮；扣篮
words.ex: He dunked the bread into his soup before eating it.
words.ex_cn: 他吃之前把面包在汤里浸泡了一下。
words.en: To dip food, especially bread, into a liquid; or to score in basketball by jumping and putting the ball through the hoop with one's hands.

words.tr: n. 支持；认可；名人代言；违章驾驶记录
words.ex: He got an endorsement from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了老板的支持。
words.en: An endorsement is a statement or action which shows that you support or approve of something or someone.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: The game will have a half-time break of 15 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 比赛将有15分钟的中场休息时间。
words.en: Half-time is the short period of time between the two parts of a sports match when the players rest and people watching the match can get refreshments.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.tr: adv. 不可能地；无法可想地
words.ex: The task was impossibly difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这项任务几乎是不可能完成的。
words.en: In a manner that is not possible or is extremely difficult to believe or achieve.

words.tr: adj. 与真人或实物一样大小的
words.ex: The artist created a life-size portrait of the queen.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家创作了一幅与女王真人一样大小的肖像。
words.en: A life-size model or picture is the same size as the person or thing that it represents.

words.tr: adj. （艺术作品）与真人[实物]一样大的
words.ex: The statue is life-sized and stands in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像尺寸与真人一样，立在公园里。
words.en: Having the same size as the original or the person or thing being represented.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.ex: The benefits outweigh the risks.
words.ex_cn: 好处超过了风险。
words.en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The statue was placed on a marble pedestal.
words.ex_cn: 雕像被放置在大理石底座上。
words.en: A pedestal is the base or support on which a statue, obelisk, or column is mounted.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: He wears a pair of sneakers to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一双运动鞋去学校。
