words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: He briefly explained the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地解释了这个计划。
words.en: For a short time; in few words.

words.ex: His conception of the new app was simple but clever.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新应用的构想简单而巧妙。
words.en: A conception is an idea or a plan that someone has in their mind.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.ex: As a latecomer to the meeting, he had to catch up on what he missed.
words.ex_cn: 作为会议的迟到者，他不得不赶上他错过的事情。
words.en: A latecomer is someone who arrives after the expected or usual time.

words.ex: He tries to oversimplify the problem, but it is still hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图过分简化这个问题，但仍然很难理解。
words.en: If you say that someone oversimplifies something, you mean that they describe or explain it so simply that what they say is no longer true or reasonable.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: I am terribly sorry for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我为这个错误非常抱歉。
words.en: Used to emphasize the extreme degree of something.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: The vagueness of his answer made me confused.
words.ex_cn: 他回答的模糊让我感到困惑。
words.en: The quality or state of being unclear, indefinite, or indistinct.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: 短语动词。为……而暂停；中断（某事）以便进行（另一活动），例如：Let's break for lunch.（我们休息一下吃午饭吧。）
words.ex: Let's break for lunch and continue this discussion afterward.
words.ex_cn: 我们先休息一下吃午饭，然后再继续讨论。
words.en: To pause an activity temporarily, especially for rest or refreshment.

words.tr: phrase. 说实话；坦率地讲；凭良心说
words.ex: In all honesty, I don't think we can win this game.
words.ex_cn: 说实话，我认为我们赢不了这场比赛。
words.en: If you say something in all honesty, you are emphasizing that you are telling the truth and that you want people to believe you.

words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.ex: The agriculturist studied the effects of different soil types on crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 这位农学家研究了不同土壤类型对作物生长的影响。
words.en: An agriculturist is a person who is an expert in the science, art, or practice of cultivating the soil, producing crops, and raising livestock.

words.ex: She consciously chose to walk instead of driving.
words.ex_cn: 她有意识地选择走路而不是开车。
words.en: If you do something consciously, you do it deliberately, being fully aware of your actions and their possible effects.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.tr: n. 扭曲；歪曲；失真；畸变；
words.ex: The photo showed distortion in the lines.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中的线条出现了扭曲。
words.en: A distortion is a change, twist, or exaggeration that makes something appear different from the way it really is.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: He reluctantly agreed to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地同意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you do something reluctantly, you do it unwillingly.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: It is unreasonable to expect help without asking.
words.ex_cn: 不请求帮助就指望别人帮忙是不合理的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unreasonable, you mean that they are behaving in a way that is not fair or sensible.

words.ex: The doctor sensed the urgency and acted quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生感受到了紧急情况，迅速采取了行动。
words.en: The quality or condition of being urgent; pressing importance.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 受支配；从属于；受制；常遭受...
words.ex: He is subject to fines if he breaks the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果他违反规则，就会被罚款。
words.en: If someone or something is subject to something, especially something bad, it is likely or certain to be affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 让某人干等；使某人不耐烦地等待
words.ex: He had to cool his heels outside the office because the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在办公室外干等，因为会议推迟了。
words.en: To be forced to wait for someone or something, often for a long time.

words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.tr: phrase. 正在考虑；正被谈论的；讨论中的；可怀疑
words.ex: The job in question is still available.
words.ex_cn: 正在讨论的工作仍然空缺。
words.en: The person, thing, or group that is in question is the one that you have been talking about or that is involved in the situation you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 响亮而清楚地；明白无误地
words.ex: The message came through loud and clear.
words.ex_cn: 信息传达得清晰响亮。
words.en: If something is loud and clear, it is very clear and easy to understand, often because it is said in a very direct way.

words.ex: I'm sick and tired of all the noise.
words.ex_cn: 我对所有的噪音感到非常厌烦。
words.en: If you are sick and tired of something, you are annoyed and bored by it and want it to stop.

words.tr: 短语. 大意是；意思是说（用于引述某人话语或文件内容的主旨）
words.ex: He left a note to the effect that he would be late.
words.ex_cn: 他留下一张字条，大意是他将会迟到。
words.en: Phrase used to indicate that the meaning or gist of something is being conveyed, without quoting it exactly.

chapters.name: Unit 9 Part Two New Words

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: The atomic structure of hydrogen is simple.
words.ex_cn: 氢的原子结构很简单。
words.en: relating to atoms or the energy that comes from splitting atoms

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: The blacksmith makes horseshoes with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠用锤子打马蹄铁。
words.en: A blacksmith is a person who makes and repairs things in iron by hand.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: He was emotionally hurt by her words.
words.ex_cn: 他感情上被她的话伤害了。
words.en: In a way that relates to emotions or feelings.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The scientist did experimentation to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家做了实验来寻找答案。
words.en: The process of performing scientific experiments in order to test a hypothesis or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr: adv. 成几何级数地；几何图形地
words.ex: The shapes are arranged geometrically.
words.ex_cn: 这些形状是按几何方式排列的。
words.en: In a way that relates to geometry or the methods of geometry.

words.ex: She stored the leftovers in the icebox to keep them fresh.
words.ex_cn: 她把剩菜放在冰箱里保鲜。
words.en: A refrigerator or a box where ice is used to keep food cold.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The reporter tried to show objectivity in the news story.
words.ex_cn: 记者试图在新闻报道中体现客观性。
words.en: Objectivity is the quality of being objective, which means not influenced by personal feelings or opinions in considering and representing facts.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr: v. 彻底变革；使革命化；
words.ex: The new technology will revolutionize how we learn.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将彻底变革我们的学习方式。
words.en: To completely change something, especially in a way that improves it.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

chapters.name: Unit 9 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语动词. 恢复呼吸；歇一口气；（因惊讶或激动）屏住呼吸
words.ex: He stopped to catch his breath after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后停下来喘口气。
words.en: To pause and rest after physical exertion in order to regain normal breathing.

words.tr: 短语动词，意思是心里有某个想法、计划或偏好；心中已有打算
words.ex: I have something in mind for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我脑子里有个晚餐的想法。
words.en: To be thinking of a particular plan or idea.

words.tr: 短语动词，心里想着某人；有某个特定的人选
words.ex: I have someone in mind for the job.
words.ex_cn: 我有个人选适合这份工作。
words.en: To think of someone as a potential candidate or choice for something.

words.tr: phrase. 不寻常的；非凡的；特别的；与众不同的
words.ex: His behavior was out of the ordinary.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为非同寻常。
words.en: If you describe something as out of the ordinary, you mean it is unusual or different from what is normally expected.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.tr: adj. 按字母顺序的；字母的；
words.ex: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些名字是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: In the order of the letters of the alphabet.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔有15厘米长。
words.en: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a meter.

words.ex: There is a correlation between exercise and good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间存在相关性。
words.en: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr: adv. 优美地；微妙地；精致地
words.ex: She delicately placed the vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她小心翼翼地把花瓶放在桌子上。
words.en: In a manner that is very careful not to cause harm or damage; with great attention to detail.

words.ex: The evaluator assessed the performance of the software.
words.ex_cn: 评估员评估了软件的性能。
words.en: An evaluator is someone whose job is to judge the quality, importance, amount, or value of something.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.tr:
n. 亲笔文件
adj. 亲笔的
words.ex: The will was written in holograph, making it legally binding.
words.ex_cn: 这份遗嘱是亲笔写的，因此具有法律约束力。
words.en: A holograph is a photographic recording of a light field, rather than an image formed by a lens. It is used to display a fully three-dimensional image of the holographed subject, which is seen without the aid of special glasses or other intermediate optics.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: The politician used manipulation to win the election.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家通过操纵赢得了选举。
words.en: Manipulation refers to the act of controlling or influencing someone or something in a skillful but often unfair or dishonest way.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.tr: adj. 分子的；分子构成的；
words.ex: Water is a molecular compound.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种分子化合物。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of molecules.

words.ex: He is a programmer who writes code for apps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名为应用程序编写代码的程序员。
words.en: A programmer is a person who writes computer programs as a profession or hobby.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: The bridge collapsed due to resonance from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 桥梁因风引起的共振而坍塌。
words.en: Resonance is the quality in a sound of being deep, full, and reverberating.

words.ex: The music resonates with her emotions.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与她的情感产生共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates, it vibrates and produces a deep, strong sound. If a place or situation resonates, it seems full of a particular quality or feeling.

words.ex: Click the tab to open the new page.
words.ex_cn: 点击标签以打开新页面。
words.en: A tab is a small piece of material that sticks out from something, used for opening, closing, or identifying it. In computing, a tab is a key on a keyboard that moves the cursor a set number of spaces or to a specific position. In a restaurant or bar, a tab is a bill for food or drinks that is kept and paid for later.

words.tr: adj. 喜怒无常的；性情的；易兴奋的
words.ex: She is known for her temperamental nature, often changing moods without warning.
words.ex_cn: 她以喜怒无常著称，常常毫无预警地改变情绪。
words.en: If you say that someone is temperamental, you are criticizing them for not being calm or reliable, but tending to have sudden changes of mood or behavior.

words.ex: The water valve is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 这个水阀坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A valve is a device attached to a pipe or a tube which controls the flow of air or liquid through it.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 一点儿；稍微有一点（用于描述轻微的程度或症状）
words.ex: She had a touch of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 她有点流感症状。
words.en: A small amount of something, especially something that adds to the quality or character of something else.

words.tr: 短语. 一点儿，少量（用于修饰不可数名词），常带有轻微、微妙的意味；例如：a touch of humor（一点儿幽默）
words.ex: He added a touch of sugar to the tea.
words.ex_cn: 他在茶里加了一点糖。
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 密切留意；监视；随时掌握……的动态
words.ex: He keeps tabs on his friend's schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会关注朋友的日程安排。
words.en: To keep tabs on something or someone means to keep a careful watch on them or to monitor them closely.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事秘而不宣；对某事守口如瓶
words.ex: He decided to keep the secret to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他决定把秘密藏在心里。
words.en: To not tell anyone about something; to keep something secret.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为理由；基于…的原因
words.ex: He was denied entry on grounds of safety.
words.ex_cn: 他以安全为由被拒绝进入。
words.en: for the reason of; because of

words.tr: phrase. 以……为理由；基于……的原因；根据
words.ex: He was expelled from school on the grounds of misconduct.
words.ex_cn: 他因行为不端被学校开除。
words.en: Because of a particular reason or reasons.

words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: He adds antifreeze to the car in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天给汽车加防冻液。
words.en: A substance added to a liquid to lower its freezing point, used especially in the radiator of a motor vehicle.

words.ex: She looked at him apprehensively as he approached.
words.ex_cn: 当他走近时，她担心地看着他。
words.en: In a manner that shows anxiety or fear about the future or about what might happen.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场巨大的灾难。
words.en: A calamity is an event that causes great harm or damage, such as a flood or a fire.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: He requested that his body be cremated after death.
words.ex_cn: 他要求死后将他的遗体火化。
words.en: To cremate a dead person's body means to burn it, usually as part of a funeral ceremony.

words.ex: The concept of cryonics has sparked both fascination and skepticism.
words.ex_cn: 人体冷冻法的概念引发了人们的极大兴趣和怀疑。
words.en: Cryonics is the practice of preserving a person's body at an extremely low temperature with the hope that future medical technology will be able to revive them.

words.tr: n．低温学家：研究低温保存生物体的科学家，尤指研究将人体冷冻保存以期待未来复活的科学家。
words.ex: The cryonicist believes that future technology will be able to revive frozen individuals.
words.ex_cn: 这位低温学家相信，未来的技术将能够复活被冷冻的人。
words.en: A cryonicist is a person who studies or supports the practice of preserving humans or animals in a cryonic state with the hope that future medical technology will be able to revive them.

words.ex: The deterioration of the road made driving dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 道路的恶化使驾驶变得危险。
words.en: The process of becoming progressively worse.

words.tr: adj. 令人不安的；令人慌张的；令人窘迫的； v. “disconcert”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise was disconcerting.
words.ex_cn: 那阵响声令人不安。
words.en: If you say that something is disconcerting, you mean that it makes you feel anxious, confused, or embarrassed.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.ex: The embryo grows inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在母亲的子宫内生长。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

words.ex: He equates success with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功等同于幸福。
words.en: To consider one thing to be the same as or equal to another thing.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: The new software is for the facilitation of daily tasks.
words.ex_cn: 这个新软件是为了简化日常任务。
words.en: The act of making something easier or helping it to happen.

words.tr: n. 长颈瓶；烧瓶；携带用扁瓶；保温瓶
words.ex: He poured the liquid into a glass flask.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒进了一个玻璃长颈瓶里。
words.en: A flask is a bottle or other container which is used in science laboratories and industry for holding liquids.

words.ex: Glycerin is commonly used as a humectant in skincare products.
words.ex_cn: 甘油常被用作护肤品中的保湿剂。
words.en: Glycerin is a thick, sweet, colorless liquid that is used in making medicines, explosives, and antifreeze, and in food and skin care products.

words.tr: adj. 不能修复的；不可弥补的；无可挽救的
words.ex: The damage was irreparable.
words.ex_cn: 损坏是无法修复的。
words.en: If something is irreparable, it cannot be repaired or corrected.

words.ex: He likens his job to a puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的工作比作一个拼图。
words.en: To liken something to something else is to say that they are similar in some way.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: adv. 亲切地；钟爱地；深情地
words.ex: She looked at her child lovingly.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地看着她的孩子。
words.en: In a way that shows love or affection.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: His decision shows clear rationality.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定显示出清晰的理性。
words.en: Rationality is the quality or state of being rational, based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: The speaker's words reanimated the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 演讲者的话鼓舞了人群。
words.en: To bring back to life or consciousness; to revive.

words.tr: v. 重组；重新设立；使（脱水食物等）恢复原状
words.ex: The committee was reconstituted to address the new challenges.
words.ex_cn: 委员会被重组以应对新的挑战。
words.en: To reconstitute something means to change it back to its original form or to a different form by adding water or another liquid.

words.ex: The doctor performed resuscitation after the heart stopped.
words.ex_cn: 心脏停止后，医生进行了复苏。
words.en: The act of reviving someone from unconsciousness or apparent death.

words.tr: n. 摇杆；摇椅；摇滚歌手
words.ex: He spent the evening gently rocking in his favorite rocker.
words.ex_cn: 他整个晚上都在他最喜欢的摇椅上轻轻地摇晃。
words.en: A rocker is a chair mounted on rockers or springs which allows it to move back and forth, or a musician who plays rock music.

words.ex: The rupture in the pipe caused a flood.
words.ex_cn: 管道的破裂导致了洪水。
words.en: A rupture is a severe injury in which an internal part of your body tears or bursts open, or the act of breaking or bursting something.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: He is skeptical about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: If you are skeptical about something, you have doubts about it.

words.ex: The old lamp burned sperm for light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏旧灯用鲸蜡油照明。
words.en: The male reproductive cell; spermatozoon.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr: n. 悬浮；暂时停职（停学、停赛）；
words.ex: The suspension of dust in the air made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 空气中的尘埃悬浮使天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。
words.en: The act of temporarily stopping something from happening or being in effect, or the state of being stopped in this way.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. adj. 精神失常的；发疯的；行为古怪的
words.ex: He must be off his rocker to think he can get away with that.
words.ex_cn: 他一定是疯了，才会认为他能逃脱惩罚。
words.en: If you say that someone is off their rocker, you mean that they are behaving in a very strange or foolish way, often because they are crazy.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.ex: He equates success with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功等同于幸福。
words.en: To consider one thing to be the same as or equal to another thing.

words.tr: phrase. 高度尊重某人；对某人非常敬重
words.ex: I hold my teacher in high regard because she is kind and wise.
words.ex_cn: 我非常尊敬我的老师，因为她既善良又智慧。
words.en: To have a great deal of respect or admiration for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 高度重视某事物；对某事物非常尊重
words.ex: People hold teachers in high regard for their hard work.
words.ex_cn: 人们非常尊重教师的辛勤工作。
words.en: To have a lot of respect for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 处于……状态；处于……状况
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: In a particular state or situation.

chapters.name: Unit 10 Part Two New Words

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.ex: The bard sang a song about love and war.
words.ex_cn: 这位吟游诗人唱了一首关于爱情与战争的歌。
words.en: A bard is a poet, traditionally one who recites epic poems and is associated with a particular oral tradition.

words.tr: adv. 气喘吁吁地；屏息地
words.ex: She ran breathlessly up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 她气喘吁吁地跑上楼梯。
words.en: In a way that shows you are breathing very quickly or with difficulty, especially because you are excited or have been running.

words.tr: n. 土音（尤指爱尔兰人讲英语时的土腔），（旧时爱尔兰人穿的）粗革皮鞋
words.ex: He speaks with a thick brogue.
words.ex_cn: 他说话带着浓重的口音。
words.en: A brogue is a type of shoe, traditionally a low-heeled, leather shoe with decorative perforations. It can also refer to a strong accent, especially an Irish one.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.tr:
v. 猛击；打；击
n. 敲打；猛击；影响力
words.ex: He clouted the ball with his bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒猛击了球。
words.en: Clout refers to the power or influence that someone has, especially in politics or business.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.tr: v. 考试不及格；给不及格分数
words.ex: He flunked math last semester.
words.ex_cn: 他上学期数学没及格。
words.en: If you flunk an exam or a course, you fail to reach the required standard.

words.tr:
v. 乱摸；摸索；笨手笨脚地做
n. 摸索；笨手笨脚
words.ex: He fumbled for his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中乱摸着找钥匙。
words.en: If you fumble with something, you try to hold, move, or find it with your hands in a clumsy way.

words.tr: adv. 严肃地；庄重地；严重地
words.ex: He looked gravely at the broken glass.
words.ex_cn: 他严肃地看着那块碎玻璃。
words.en: In a serious or solemn manner.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.ex: He is an illustrious scientist who won many awards.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位杰出的科学家，获得过许多奖项。
words.en: If you describe someone as illustrious, you mean that they are very well known because they have a high position in society or they have done something impressive.

words.tr: adv. 愤怒地，愤慨地，愤愤不平地
words.ex: She responded indignantly to the accusation.
words.ex_cn: 她愤怒地回应了指控。
words.en: In a manner indicating anger or annoyance at something perceived as unfair.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr: n. 纪念品；用以回忆的东西
words.ex: She keeps a photo as a memento of her trip.
words.ex_cn: 她保留了一张照片作为旅行的纪念品。
words.en: A memento is an object which you keep because it reminds you of a person or a special event.

words.ex: The judge showed mercy and let him go free.
words.ex_cn: 法官仁慈地让他自由了。
words.en: If someone in authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；含糊地说
n. 含糊的话；咕哝
words.ex: He mumbles when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会嘟囔。
words.en: If you mumble, you speak very quietly and not at all clearly with the result that the words are difficult to understand.

words.ex: He has a small mustache.
words.ex_cn: 他有一小撮胡子。
words.en: A mustache is a strip of hair left to grow above the upper lip.

words.tr: n. 纸板，<俚>纸牌 adj. 纸板做的，不坚实的
words.ex: He cut out shapes from the pasteboard.
words.ex_cn: 他从纸板上剪出形状。
words.en: Pasteboard is a type of stiff cardboard made by pasting together sheets of paper.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.ex: He wrote the book for posterity.
words.ex_cn: 他写这本书是为了留给后人。
words.en: All future generations of people.

words.ex: She dressed primly for the interview.
words.ex_cn: 她为面试穿得端庄得体。
words.en: In a precise and proper manner, often implying a stiffness or formality.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.tr: v. 侧向移动；悄悄贴近
words.ex: She sidled up to him and whispered in his ear.
words.ex_cn: 她侧身悄悄靠近他，在他耳边低语。
words.en: To move sideways or obliquely, especially in a stealthy or furtive manner.

words.tr: n. 头脑简单的人；傻瓜；笨蛋
words.ex: He is a simpleton who believes everything he hears.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，什么都信。
words.en: A simpleton is someone who is not very intelligent and who is easily tricked or deceived.

words.tr: adj. 散乱的; 蔓延的; 落后的; 脱离行列的
words.ex: The straggly hair made her look unkempt.
words.ex_cn: 散乱的头发让她看起来不修边幅。
words.en: Growing or spreading out in a scattered or irregular way.

words.tr:
v. 臆测；猜想
n. 臆测；猜度
words.ex: He surmises that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you surmise that something is true, you guess it from the available evidence, although you do not know for certain.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: The temporal change of seasons affects our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 季节的时间变化影响我们的日常生活。
words.en: Relating to time as opposed to eternity; relating to worldly life as opposed to spiritual life.

words.tr: n. 移动；转送；转让；调动
words.ex: The transference of water from the river to the field took hours.
words.ex_cn: 水从河流转移到田地花了几个小时。
words.en: The act of transferring something or someone from one place, position, or person to another.

words.ex: The box remained untouched on the table.
words.ex_cn: 盒子原封不动地留在桌子上。
words.en: If something is untouched, it has not been changed or affected by something.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

chapters.name: Unit 10 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. v. 努力学习；温习；加强了解（某主题）
words.ex: She decided to bone up on her French before her trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在去巴黎之前温习一下法语。
words.en: To study intensively for a short period of time, especially in preparation for an exam or test.

words.tr: phrase. 变得疯狂；发疯；失去理智
words.ex: He goes mad when he hears loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声噪音时，他会发疯。
words.en: To become very angry or to lose one's sanity.

words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.tr: phrase. 润色；改进；使更完善；擦亮
words.ex: He will polish up his English before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他将在旅行前把英语提高一下。
words.en: To improve or refine something, especially a skill or piece of work, by making small changes.

words.ex: They think highly of their teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们非常尊敬他们的老师。
words.en: To have a very good opinion of someone or something; to regard someone or something with great respect or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. v.草率完成：指迅速、轻松地完成某项任务，通常是因为不太重视或不想花太多时间在这个任务上。
words.ex: He can toss off a quick drawing in just a few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他几分钟就能随手画一幅简笔画。
words.en: To do something quickly and without much effort; to drink something quickly.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.ex: He faced an accusation of stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他面临偷钱的指控。
words.en: An accusation is a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal.

words.ex: He signed the affidavit before the lawyer.
words.ex_cn: 他在律师面前签署了宣誓书。
words.en: A written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation, for use as evidence in court.

words.ex: He screamed in agony after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后痛苦地大叫。
words.en: Agony is very severe physical or mental pain.

words.ex: He drank a glass of ale at the pub.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧喝了一杯麦芽酒。
words.en: Ale is a type of beer that is brewed using a warm fermentation method, resulting in a sweet, full-bodied and fruity taste.

words.tr: n. （身体或精神的）极度痛苦
words.ex: He felt deep anguish after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 失去狗后，他感到极度痛苦。
words.en: Anguish is extreme mental suffering or physical pain.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: His claim is baseless.
words.ex_cn: 他的说法没有根据。
words.en: If you describe an accusation, rumor, or report as baseless, you mean that it is not true and is not based on facts.

words.ex: Behold the beautiful sunset.
words.ex_cn: 看那美丽的日落。
words.en: To see or observe (someone or something, especially something remarkable or impressive).

words.ex: The wind blew bitterly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风刺骨地吹过树林。
words.en: In a way that is filled with or marked by strong negative emotions such as anger, sorrow, or disappointment.

words.tr:
n. 勒索；敲诈
v. 勒索；讹诈
words.ex: He threatened to tell the truth unless she paid him money — that's blackmail.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁说，除非她付钱，否则就说出真相——这就是敲诈。
words.en: Blackmail is the action of threatening to reveal a secret about someone, unless they do something you want, such as give you money.

words.ex: He went to jail for bribery.
words.ex_cn: 他因贿赂而入狱。
words.en: Bribery is the act of offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting something of value for the purpose of influencing the action of an official in the discharge of his or her public or legal duties.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.tr: n. 候选人的资格（或身份）
words.ex: He applied for the job because of his strong candidacy.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了这份工作，因为他的候选人资格很强。
words.en: Candidacy is the state of being a candidate in an election.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.ex: The climax of the movie was a big chase scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的高潮是一场大追捕场景。
words.en: The climax is the most exciting or important part of a play, film, or piece of music, which usually happens near the end.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.tr: n. 行贿的人，舞弊政治家
words.ex: The corruptionist was caught red-handed accepting bribes.
words.ex_cn: 那个行贿的人被当场抓住接受贿赂。
words.en: A corruptionist is someone who engages in or supports corruption, especially in a political context.

words.tr: adj. 死去了的；已死的；亡故的； v. “decease”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The deceased man was buried last week.
words.ex_cn: 这位已故的男子上周被埋葬了。
words.en: Someone who is deceased has died.

words.tr: n. 精神错乱；谵妄；极度兴奋
words.ex: The patient was in a state of delirium after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 手术后，病人处于精神错乱的状态。
words.en: A state of wild excitement or mental confusion, often accompanied by hallucinations.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: It was disgraceful to lie to your teacher.
words.ex_cn: 对老师撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you say that something is disgraceful, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or wrong, and that you find it completely unacceptable.

words.tr: adj. 使人沮丧的 v. dishearten（使泄气）的现在分词形式
words.ex: The bad weather was disheartening for the runners.
words.ex_cn: 糟糕的天气让跑步者感到沮丧。
words.en: If something is disheartening, it makes you feel disappointed and less confident or less hopeful.

words.ex: The drunken man stumbled down the street.
words.ex_cn: 那个醉汉摇摇晃晃地走在街上。
words.en: Someone who is drunken is drunk or frequently gets drunk.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.ex: He told a falsehood to avoid punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一个谎言来避免惩罚。
words.en: A falsehood is a statement that is not true; a lie.

words.ex: The floor was filthy after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨过后，地板变得非常肮脏。
words.en: Something that is filthy is extremely dirty.

words.tr: adj. 州长的；统治者的；地方长官的
words.ex: The gubernatorial election was held last week.
words.ex_cn: 州长选举上周举行。
words.en: Gubernatorial is used to describe something that is related to a governor or the position of governor.

words.ex: He gave a heartless reply to her plea.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的恳求给出了无情的答复。
words.en: If you describe someone as heartless, you mean that they are cruel and unkind, and have no sympathy for anyone or anything.

words.ex: He tried to incite a riot with his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过演讲煽动暴乱。
words.en: To incite someone to do something means to encourage or persuade them to do it, often in a way that is negative or harmful.

words.tr: adj. 臭名远扬的；声名狼藉的；
words.ex: He is an infamous thief who stole from many banks.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个臭名远扬的窃贼，偷过许多银行。
words.en: If you say that someone is infamous, you mean that they are well known because they have done something bad.

words.tr: n. （医院或监狱中的）同宿者；监犯
words.ex: The inmate shared his cell with two others.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯和另外两个人共用一间牢房。
words.en: A person who is confined in a prison, hospital, or other institution.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.ex: The kangaroo jumps high in the Australian wild.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的野外跳得很高。
words.en: A kangaroo is a large Australian animal which moves by jumping on its back legs. Female kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch on their stomach.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一瓶酒。
words.en: Liquor is an alcoholic drink that is made by distillation rather than by fermentation.

words.tr: adv. 无精打采地，冷淡地
words.ex: She walked listlessly through the park.
words.ex_cn: 她无精打采地走过公园。
words.en: If someone is listless, they lack energy or enthusiasm.

words.ex: The lunatic was taken to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 那个疯人被送到了医院。
words.en: A lunatic is someone who behaves in a crazy or very foolish way.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: The fallen tree obstructs the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树挡住了道路。
words.en: If something obstructs a road or path, it blocks it, stopping people or vehicles from getting past.

words.ex: The perjurer was sentenced to prison for his false testimony.
words.ex_cn: 伪证者因作伪证被判入狱。
words.en: A perjurer is someone who commits perjury, which is the act of lying or making false statements under oath in a court of law.

words.ex: He was charged with perjury after lying in court.
words.ex_cn: 他在法庭上撒谎后被控伪证罪。
words.en: The crime of telling a lie in a court of law after having sworn to tell the truth.

words.ex: He faced persecution for his beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他因自己的信仰而遭受迫害。
words.en: Persecution is the act of treating someone cruelly or unfairly, especially because of their race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: The plantain is often used in Caribbean cooking.
words.ex_cn: 车前草常用于加勒比烹饪。
words.en: A plantain is a type of large banana that is used in cooking. It is also a name for a common weed with broad leaves.

words.ex: The rattlesnake hissed and shook its tail.
words.ex_cn: 响尾蛇嘶嘶作响并摇动尾巴。
words.en: A rattlesnake is a venomous snake known for the rattle at the end of its tail, which it uses as a warning signal to potential predators.

words.tr: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；
words.ex: The republican government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 共和国政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A republican is a person who supports or belongs to the Republican Party, which is one of the two main political parties in the United States. It can also refer to someone who supports a republic as a form of government.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: It is shameful to lie to your friends.
words.ex_cn: 对朋友撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour or attitude as shameful, you think that it is so bad that the person ought to be ashamed.

words.tr: adj. 无耻的；脸皮厚的；不知羞耻的
words.ex: He gave a shameless excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个无耻的借口。
words.en: If you describe someone as shameless, you mean that they should be ashamed of their behavior, which is unacceptable to other people.

words.tr:
v. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
n. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
words.ex: He spread slander about his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他散布了关于他邻居的诽谤。
words.en: Slander is the action or crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation.

words.ex: The police caught the snatcher who stole the woman's bag.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了偷女人包的小偷。
words.en: A snatcher is someone who takes something quickly and often violently, especially in a way that is illegal.

words.ex: He looked suspiciously at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 他可疑地盯着那个陌生人。
words.en: In a manner that arouses suspicion or mistrust.

words.ex: The undercurrents of the river were strong and dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 河中的暗流强劲且危险。
words.en: An undercurrent is a current of water below the surface or an underlying feeling or influence, especially one that is hidden or not openly acknowledged.

words.tr: adj. 糟糕透顶的；恶劣的；卑鄙的
words.ex: He said a vile thing to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友说了句卑鄙的话。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is vile, you mean that they are extremely unpleasant.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.ex: The withdrawal of the offer surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 撤销这项提议让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of removing or taking something away, especially money from a bank account, or the process of stopping taking a drug or medicine.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.tr: 短语动词. 把某事归咎于某人
words.ex: He blames his failure on his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的失败归咎于他的老师。
words.en: To say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad that has happened.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把某事归咎于某事物；将某问题的责任推到某事物上
words.ex: He blames his bad mood on the rainy weather.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的坏心情归咎于下雨的天气。
words.en: To say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；拆卸；拍板成交；获得（收入）；降低（价格）；减（量）
words.ex: The strong wind can knock down the small tree.
words.ex_cn: 强风能把小树吹倒。
words.en: To knock someone or something down means to cause them to fall to the ground by hitting them, often with a vehicle or by physical force.

words.tr: phrase. 戳穿谎言；拆穿假话
words.ex: He tried to hide the truth, but she nailed the lie with one question.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐瞒真相，但她一个问题就揭穿了谎言。
words.en: To expose or prove that something is a lie.

words.tr: phrase. 派遣；提交；呈送（如文件、申请等）
words.ex: The army will send in troops to help.
words.ex_cn: 军队将派遣部队去帮忙。
words.en: To submit or deliver something, typically a document or application, to a particular place or person.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 悄悄离开；溜走；逐渐消逝
words.ex: He slipped away without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄离开了，没有说再见。
words.en: To leave a place quietly or secretly, or to gradually disappear or become less.

words.tr: phrase. 向…报仇；对…进行报复
words.ex: He vowed to take vengeance on the man who wronged him.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要向冤枉他的人报复。
words.en: To take vengeance on someone means to harm or punish them because they have harmed you or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 向……报仇；对……实施报复
words.ex: He swore to take vengeance upon his enemies.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要对他的敌人进行报复。
words.en: To inflict harm in return for a wrong suffered; to seek retribution.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: The acme of his career was winning the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的顶点是获得诺贝尔奖。
words.en: The highest point of achievement or excellence.

words.ex: He denied the allegation of stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认了偷钱的指控。
words.en: An allegation is a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal.

words.tr: v. 结盟；“ally”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Two countries allied to fight the common enemy.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家结盟以对抗共同的敌人。
words.en: Allied means joined by or relating to members of an alliance.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: His arrogance made others dislike him.
words.ex_cn: 他的傲慢让其他人不喜欢他。
words.en: Arrogance is the quality of being arrogant, which means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.

words.ex: The assembly of the car took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的装配花了三天时间。
words.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose, such as a meeting or a legislative session. It can also refer to the process of fitting together the component parts of a machine or other object.

words.tr: n. 生命本源，自我; 至高精神法则
words.ex: In Hindu philosophy, atman is considered the essence of one's true self.
words.ex_cn: 在印度哲学中，阿特曼被认为是个人真实自我的本质。
words.en: In Hindu philosophy, the atman is the individual soul or self, considered as eternal and divine.

words.ex: It was an auspicious day for their wedding.
words.ex_cn: 那天是他们婚礼的吉日。
words.en: If you describe something as auspicious, you mean that it is a sign of future success.

words.tr: n. 影响；方位；轴承；举止； v. 忍受；“bear”的现在分词；
words.ex: The new policy has a big bearing on our daily lives.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对我们日常生活有很大影响。
words.en: The manner in which one conducts or carries oneself, including posture and gestures; also refers to a machine part that supports another part and reduces friction.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.ex: He got a demerit for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而被扣分。
words.en: A demerit is a fault or disadvantage.

words.ex: The lion returned to its den at night.
words.ex_cn: 狮子晚上回到了它的兽穴。
words.en: A den is the home of certain types of wild animals such as lions or foxes, or a place where someone feels safe and private.

words.ex: The old man walked with a dignified posture.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人以有尊严的姿态行走。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is dignified, you mean they are calm, impressive and deserve respect.

words.ex: The child's emulation of his father made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿父亲的样子让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Emulation is the effort or desire to equal or surpass another in some achievement or quality, often through imitation.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.ex: His faithfulness to his wife never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对妻子的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being faithful; loyalty.

words.ex: He showed humility after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得奖品后表现出了谦逊。
words.en: Humility is the quality of being humble and not thinking that you are better than other people.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.ex: This custom has existed from time immemorial.
words.ex_cn: 这个习俗从远古时代就存在了。
words.en: Something that is immemorial has existed or been happening for such a long time that it cannot be remembered.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.ex: The monarch ruled the country for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 这位君主统治这个国家长达50年。
words.en: A monarch is a king, queen, emperor, or empress.

words.ex: He found nirvana after meditating for years.
words.ex_cn: 他经过多年的冥想后找到了涅槃。
words.en: In Buddhism, nirvana is the ultimate state of liberation from suffering and the cycle of rebirth.

words.tr:
n. （赎罪的）苦行；苦修；忏悔
v. 使...以苦行赎罪
words.ex: He performed penance for his sins.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的罪行忏悔。
words.en: Penance is the act of doing something to show that you are sorry for something wrong that you have done, especially in some religions.

words.tr: n. 俾格米人; 特别矮小的人或动物，特别小的东西 adj. 非常小的
words.ex: The pigmy elephant is one of the smallest elephant species.
words.ex_cn: 俾格米象是体型最小的象种之一。
words.en: A pigmy is a member of a group of very small people who live in central Africa.

words.tr: adj. 虔诚的；信神的；伪善的
words.ex: He is a pious man who prays every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天祈祷的虔诚的人。
words.en: Someone who is pious is very religious and moral.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.ex: He tries to procure food for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力为家人获取食物。
words.en: To obtain something, especially with care or effort.

words.ex: He refuted the claim with clear evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的证据驳斥了这一说法。
words.en: To prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; to deny the truth or accuracy of something.

words.tr:
adj. 据说的；号称的；有名气的
v. 认为；以为；“repute”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a reputed doctor in this city.
words.ex_cn: 他是这座城市里有名的医生。
words.en: Generally believed to be a particular thing, although this might not be true.

words.ex: Each student received their respective book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都收到了他们各自的书。
words.en: Relating or belonging separately to each of two or more people or things.

words.ex: He showed reverence for his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他对祖父表示尊敬。
words.en: A feeling of profound respect for someone or something.

words.ex: She added sage to the stuffing for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在感恩节晚餐的填料中加入了鼠尾草。
words.en: A sage is a person who is regarded as being very wise, especially someone who is known for their good judgment and deep understanding of life.

words.tr:
adj. 唯一的；
n. 鞋底；
words.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。
words.en: If you describe something as the sole thing of a particular kind, you mean that it is the only one of that kind.

words.ex: The country values its sovereignty.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家重视它的主权。
words.en: Sovereignty is the power that a country has to govern itself or another country or state.

words.ex: His stature in the scientific community is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学界声望很高。
words.en: The height of a person or an animal in a standing position; the level of respect that people have for a person or organization because of their importance or success.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.ex: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹喇叭。
words.en: A trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a flared bell and three valves, producing a bright, penetrating tone.

words.ex: The soldier was honored for his valor in battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位士兵因在战斗中的英勇表现而受到表彰。
words.en: Valor is great courage, especially in a battle or war.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: The baby grows in the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。
words.en: The organ in the lower body of a woman or female mammal where offspring are conceived and in which they gestate before birth.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He came forth to speak the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他站出来讲真话。
words.en: To appear or emerge from somewhere.

words.ex: He will come forward to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他将站出来说出真相。
words.en: If someone comes forward, they offer to do something or to give some information in response to a request for help.

words.ex: The project failed for want of funding.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目因缺乏资金而失败。
words.en: Because of a lack of something.

words.tr: phrase. 自古以来；远古时代起
words.ex: This tradition has been practiced from time immemorial.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统自古以来就被实践。
words.en: Since a very long time ago; from ancient times.

words.tr: phrase. 自远古以来；自无法追忆的年代起
words.ex: People have been living in this valley since time immemorial.
words.ex_cn: 自古以来，人们就居住在这个山谷中。
words.en: Since a time that is so long ago that people have no knowledge or memory of it.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 每个人；所有人；诸位
words.ex: The teacher thanked one and all for their hard work.
words.ex_cn: 老师感谢每个人的辛勤工作。
words.en: Everyone, without exception.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人相形见绌；使某人感到羞愧；让某人自愧不如
words.ex: Her kindness puts others to shame.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良让别人感到羞愧。
words.en: To make someone feel ashamed or inferior by comparison.

words.tr: phrase. 彻头彻尾地；从核心上；从根本上
words.ex: She was British to the core.
words.ex_cn: 她是个彻头彻尾的英国人。
words.en: Completely or thoroughly.
